context_for_next_testing_agent: Magic Analysis feature fully functional. Located under Analysis tab in ProjectView. Test data has strong age-salary correlation (0.99) which is correctly detected. backend_endpoints.magic_analyze: GET /api/analysis/{project_id}/magic-analyze - Returns comprehensive analysis with executive_summary, data_profile, data_quality, cleaning_suggestions, key_insights, suggested_visualizations, next_steps, analysis_timestamp
backend_endpoints.magic_apply_cleaning: POST /api/analysis/{project_id}/magic-apply-cleaning - Applies cleaning operations (null handling, type conversion, text normalization, duplicate removal)

frontend_components.magic_analysis_tab: Tab in Analysis section for one-click analysis
frontend_components.executive_summary: Quality score ring, plain-English text, data stats (rows, columns, missing, duplicates)
frontend_components.data_quality_tab: Shows quality score, critical/warning/info issue counts, issues list
frontend_components.cleaning_tab: Shows cleaning suggestions with strategy options (mean, median, mode, etc.) or 'No cleaning needed' message
frontend_components.insights_tab: Shows discovered patterns - correlations, distributions, ML readiness
frontend_components.suggested_charts_tab: Visualization recommendations - histograms, scatter plots, heatmaps, bar charts

analysis_features.quality_score: 0-100 score based on missing values, duplicates, dataset size
analysis_features.correlation_detection: Detects strong correlations (r > 0.7) with plain-English descriptions
analysis_features.ml_readiness: Notes when data is suitable for ML (3+ numeric columns)
analysis_features.cleaning_strategies: mean, median, mode, forward_fill, constant, drop_rows for missing values; remove_duplicates for duplicates; to_numeric, trim, lowercase for type/text issues

mocked_apis.status: NONE - All features use local statistical/ML methods
mocked_apis.details: Uses pandas for data manipulation, numpy/scipy for statistics, sklearn for ML analysis. No external LLM APIs.
